paper_title: Long-baseline quantum sensor network as dark matter haloscope
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon, dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 3b
notes: AMAILS: long-baseline network of 15 SERF atomic magnetometers in two 2x2x2 m shielded rooms (Suzhou/Harbin, 1692 km baseline) searching for dark-photon dark matter via kinetic mixing, frequency range 1-500 Hz (mass 4.1 feV to 2.1 peV), 95% C.L. The only explicit numerical limit stated in the text is eps ~ 5e-6 at 2.1 peV (500 Hz). The low-mass endpoint at 4.1 feV is ESTIMATED by scaling eps ~ 1/m_A' (since induced B-field ~ eps*m_A' at fixed magnetometer sensitivity), giving ~2.5e-3; the actual exclusion curve is in Fig. 3b but numerical values are not tabulated in the text. Local DM density assumed rho = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Also includes a future projection (up to 6 orders of magnitude improvement) shown as separate line in Fig. 3b, not extracted here. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 44)) | Vision: Exclusion plot is Fig. 3b (fig_02.png): blue-shaded 'This work' region excluded at 95% C.L. over 4.1 feV to 2.1 peV (1-500 Hz Compton frequency).
